item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate slightly today and tomorrow. It will be warm during the day over the region. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China between Saturday night and Sunday morning. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region on Sunday. Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon and upper-air disturbance, temperatures will drop further over southern China early to midweek next week. The weather will be cloudy with a few rain patches. It will be very cold over parts of southern China.
